title: Keyword inspector: choose the page structure
question: Same AsoBeast look, new structure for exploring around a keyword. Lock one, steer, or re-roll.

options.label: Opportunity map
options.lineage: Popularity by difficulty plot as the page's spine
options.thesis: Every keyword you inspect lands as a point on one popularity by difficulty map, so exploring is moving toward the empty, high value corner.
options.viewport: Search bar on top; a large map of this storefront's inspected keywords on the left with the sweet spot tinted; the selected keyword's scores and top 10 in a column on the right; autocomplete suggestions not inspected yet in a rail under the map.

raised.raise: The suggestion rail always shows the next hops from the selected keyword and re-signs itself after each inspection.
Apps that entered or left the top 10 since the last run stay highlighted until you open them.

options.risk: Needs a few inspections before the map says much; the first visit is a single point.

options.label: Research workbench
options.thesis: A keyword queue on the left, the live store results in the middle, the scores on the right: the whole session on one screen with no page scroll.
options.viewport: Left pane lists inspected keywords grouped by seed, with uninspected suggestions queued under each; the middle pane is the store results list; the right pane stacks popularity, difficulty, opportunity and the top 10 summary.
options.risk: Three panes get tight under 1280 px and collapse to one pane on phones.

options.label: Scorecard and tabs
options.lineage: Sticky summary header over tabbed detail
options.thesis: A compact scorecard with the verdict and the next hops stays pinned, and the detail lives behind tabs instead of one long scroll.
options.viewport: Search bar, then a one row scorecard: keyword, three scores, change since last run and autocomplete chips; below it tabs for Results, Competition, Changes and History, Results open by default.
options.risk: The most familiar of the three; tabs hide the competition summary until clicked.

options.label: Airport wayfinding
options.lineage: Terminal signage: only the choices ahead at each junction
options.thesis: Each inspection is a junction that signs only the next keywords to try.
options.case: Loses on clarity: researchers need the whole field, not one junction at a time.
options.kept: Next hops re-sign after every inspection.
options.risk: Hides the data behind a sequence.

options.label: Gate board
options.lineage: Departure boards that rerank in place
options.thesis: The top 10 as a board whose changes stay lit.
options.viewport: A board of the top results reranking between runs.
options.case: Loses on exploration: it watches one keyword instead of moving between many.
options.kept: Top 10 changes stay highlighted until seen.
